tools.name: search_availability
tools.description: Search deterministic sample stay options from the Spann Stays fixture; no live inventory or property availability is queried. Set data_source=approved_customer_catalog for actual approved customer discovery (no live inventory); select using prepare_discovered_stay and a trusted desktop browser host.

tools.name: explain_booking_constraints
tools.description: Explain fixture-backed booking constraints for a sample property and rate; no property authority or live policy decision is provided.

tools.name: prepare_reservation_action
tools.description: Prepare a fixture-only reservation action for review; never holds a room, books, pays, sends, or contacts a property. Use sample traveler placeholders only.

tools.name: get_customer_property
tools.description: Read a published customer property record with public provenance and an official handoff route; unpublished records fail closed.

tools.name: resolve_customer_route
tools.description: Resolve a published customer's official booking or inquiry URL from stay length; never checks inventory or sends an inquiry.

tools.name: get_guest_observations
tools.description: Read moderated guest observations separately from property facts; no review collection or submission.

tools.name: discover_customer_stays
tools.description: Find eligible actual owner-approved customer property records by destination and traveler fit, without knowing a property name or ID. Read-only catalog discovery; no live availability or price. Returns fit evidence, limitations, official routes and expiring selection tokens. Coverage is limited to t

tools.name: prepare_discovered_stay
tools.description: Create a Spann journey for the selected actual customer record. Returns an opaque resume credential and a trusted-desktop browser task; does not execute a browser, fill guests, accept terms, book or pay.

tools.name: get_spann_journey_status
tools.description: Resume a Spann handoff by its opaque journey credential. Preparation reports are assistant-reported; booking and payment remain unconfirmed until independently reconciled with the provider. Confirmed states require an independently authorized property/provider receipt. Never send guest/card details.

tools.name: get_spann_booking_confirmation
tools.description: Read only booking/payment confirmation for a Spann reference using its separate long-lived confirmation token. Does not resume browser work or authorize confirmation. Synthetic receipts never become real booking/payment status.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_guest_observations · Private data: prepare_reservation_action, get_customer_property, discover_customer_stays, prepare_discovered_stay, get_spann_journey_status, get_spann_booking_confirmation · Public sink: get_spann_journey_status · Destructive: prepare_discovered_stay.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_guest_observations · Private data: prepare_reservation_action, get_customer_property, discover_customer_stays, prepare_discovered_stay, get_spann_journey_status, get_spann_booking_confirmation · Public sink: get_spann_journey_status · Destructive: prepare_discovered_stay

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_availability" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Set data_source=approved_customer_catalog for actual approved customer discovery (no live inventory); select using prepare_discovered_stay and a trusted desktop browser host."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
